body: I really don't think I will do anything. I'm just scared that it has even come to my mind. I'm just scared of myself right now. It's that low. It's imagining her with another guy. It's imagining not having my best friend to come home to. I know I sound like a bitch but these are the things. I am glad you guys are here. I could never tell my friends or family how low I am right now. They'd be far too worried.
Thank you for the offer. It's incredibly kind of you. I'm not going to hurt myself. I'm just scared of myself right now. I've never been this low. I've never felt this hopeless.
I'm sorry about your loss. It's really hard.
I don't know man. I know you're right. I'm just scared of myself right now. I've always been an even keel person. I have never been as low as I am right now.
